title: This Ego Electric Mower Tamed My 2.5-Acre Lawn With Ease and in Less Time
summary: When my older, 21-inch gas mower died yet again at the start of summer, I decided it was time to jump ship for an electric mower. The Ego 1300 is a big mower, by far the biggest walk-behind mower I've ever used.
